tasks.subject: Task 1: Day boundary logic in usePersistence
tasks.description:
**Goal:** When the app hydrates and `lastSavedAt` is before today, close the active timer's log at midnight, reset timer values, and stop the timer.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/hooks/usePersistence.ts`
- Create: `src/hooks/__tests__/usePersistence.test.ts`

**Verify:** `npx vitest run src/hooks/__tests__/usePersistence.test.ts`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/hooks/usePersistence.ts", "src/hooks/__tests__/usePersistence.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run src/hooks/__tests__/usePersistence.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["day boundary closes active log at midnight", "timer values reset to zero", "activeTimerId set to null", "same-day hydration unchanged"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```
